name: openWindowParams
summary: Dictionary of options for the [Titanium.UI.Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) method.

properties.name: activityEnterAnimation
properties.summary: Animation resource to run on the activity being opened.
properties.description:
This value will be ignored if `animated` is set to false.
See "Window Transitions in Android" in the main description of Titanium.UI.Window
for more information.

examples.title: Sliding in a new Window

properties.name: activityExitAnimation
properties.summary: Animation resource to run on the activity that is being put in background as a window is being opened above it.
properties.description:
This value will be ignored if `animated` is set to false.
See "Window Transitions in Android" in the main description of Titanium.UI.Window
for more information.

properties.name: animated
properties.summary: Determines whether to use an animated effect when the window is shown.
properties.description:
On Android, this property supports animated transitions on windows
except for modal windows (`modal:true`). The transitions are on by default, but
you can disable this behavior by setting this value to `false`.

On iOS, only use this property to disable animated transitions on modal windows.
This property has unintended side effects on non-modal windows if it is defined.

properties.name: bottom
properties.summary: Window's bottom position, in platform-specific units.
properties.description: On Android, this property has no effect.

properties.name: forceModal
properties.summary: Indicates whether the window enforces modal behaviour.
properties.description: Set to `true` to prevent interactive dismissal of window while it is onscreen.

properties.name: fullscreen
properties.summary: Determines if the window is fullscreen.

properties.name: height
properties.description:
On Windows Phone and Windows 10 Mobile, this property does not take any effect.
On Windows 10 Store App, resizing Window takes no effect in following cases
according to [Windows Runtime API document](https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/apps/windows.ui.viewmanagement.applicationview.tryresizeview).
* The requested size is larger than the available work area.
* The requested size is less than the view's minimum size.
* The smallest allowed minimum size is 192 x 48 effective pixels.
* The largest allowed minimum size is 500 x 500 effective pixels.

properties.name: left
properties.summary: Window's left position, in platform-specific units.
properties.description: On Android, this property has no effect.

properties.name: modal
properties.summary: Determines whether to open the window modal in front of other windows.

properties.name: modalStyle
properties.summary: Presentation style of this modal window.

properties.name: modalTransitionStyle
properties.summary: Transition style of this modal window.

properties.name: navBarHidden
properties.summary: For modal windows, hides the nav bar (`true`) or shows the nav bar (`false`).
properties.description: On iOS, beginning with **Release 3.1.3**, this is no longer a valid parameter passed to the [Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) method.

properties.name: right
properties.summary: Window's right position, in platform-specific units.
properties.description: On Android, this property has no effect.

properties.name: top
properties.summary: Window's top position, in platform-specific units.
properties.description: On Android, this property has no effect.

properties.name: transition
properties.summary: Transition style of this non-modal window.

properties.name: width
properties.description:
On Windows Phone and Windows 10 Mobile, this property does not take any effect.
On Windows 10 Store App, resizing Window takes no effect in following cases
according to [Windows Runtime API document](https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/apps/windows.ui.viewmanagement.applicationview.tryresizeview).
* The requested size is larger than the available work area.
* The requested size is less than the view's minimum size.
* The smallest allowed minimum size is 192 x 48 effective pixels.
* The largest allowed minimum size is 500 x 500 effective pixels.
* This method is called while in while the app is running in Tablet Mode.
